title: OmicsVisor: an interactive Shiny application for exploring differential omics results

creators.name: Popp, Oliver
creators.affiliation: Technology Platform Proteomics, Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine in the Helmholtz Association (MDC), Berlin, Germany

description:
OmicsVisor is a modular R Shiny application for interactive exploration and visualisation of differential omics analysis results (proteomics, transcriptomics and related data types).

A single ID-keyed results table — features in rows, pairwise comparisons and sample intensities in columns — drives eighteen linked views: data overview, volcano plot, donut plot, UpSet plot, heatmap, PCA/UMAP, publication-quality volcano export, logFC scatter, Venn/UpSet list comparison, ID list generation from gene symbols or GMT files, box/violin/crossbar plots, a regex utility, feature correlation, GCT export for GSEA/MSigDB, and rank-based 1D enrichment analysis.

The application is ID-driven: every module keys off the same id column, so a list of identifiers copied from one view can be pasted directly into another.

Developed at the Max Delbrück Center for Molecular Medicine in the Helmholtz Association (MDC), Berlin.

Note on assets: the MIT licence covers the source code. The interface images are excluded from the licence grant; see ASSETS.md in the repository for file-by-file provenance.
